name: Windows Settings Manager Lite
final_boundary: Generate and upload the Lite candidate after the Pro listing exists. Final public Lite submission still requires the exact verified Pro and Lite Marketplace URLs/IDs in products/lite-pro-map.json and a passing strict Lite-to-Pro shipping audit.
release_gate: Windows backend smoke including Control Center snapshot shape — PASS
six-key Lite profile visual QA accepted on physical Stream Deck through the shared Pro control surface
Power Plan / Keep Awake / Previous Desktop / Next Desktop visuals physically approved
Previous / Next virtual desktop behavior physically confirmed through the shared implementation
Sleep execution intentionally not exercised by product owner; shared native implementation and automated gates accepted
deterministic Rat Art and Marketplace media dimensions — PASS
bundled profile integrity across seven device families — PASS
final public Lite submission requires verified direct Pro + Lite Marketplace URLs/IDs and strict Lite-to-Pro shipping audit

upsell.release_order: publish Pro first, then record direct Pro and Lite Marketplace URLs before Lite publication

commercial_release_boundary: After technical/physical QA passes, publish Pro first. Lite remains BLOCKED until Pro is published, both exact direct Marketplace URLs/IDs are recorded in products/lite-pro-map.json, the rebuilt Lite package contains the exact Pro URL, and tools/lite_pro_audit.py --shipping windows-settings-manager-lite passes.

current_direction.thesis: A free, coherent set of everyday Windows essentials for the broad use case: control your PC without opening Windows Settings or leaving what you are doing.
current_direction.primary_surface: six-key essentials: Lock, Sleep, Power Plan, Keep Awake, Previous Desktop, Next Desktop
current_direction.pro_upgrade: Pro expands the same use case into the complete 15-key Windows Control Center with connectivity, protected power actions, theme, and full virtual desktop management.
current_direction.state_policy: read live Windows state where available, verify state-changing controls, fail closed on uncertainty

notes: The six Lite actions are a strict subset of the physically reviewed Pro control surface.
Product owner approved the shared canonical key visuals on a physical Stream Deck.
Previous / Next virtual desktop behavior confirmed working in the shared implementation.
Power Plan and Keep Awake key presentation approved.
Sleep was intentionally not physically executed; product owner accepted the shared native implementation and automated validation.
